title: Data Custodian
summary: Technical role operating the storage, security and availability of data according to owner decisions.
body_markdown:
# Data Custodian

## Purpose

Safeguard data technically without deciding on its meaning or use.

## Responsibilities

- Operate databases and platforms.
- Implement access controls as decided.
- Run backup, recovery and retention jobs.
- Provide technical metadata.

## Decision Rights

Technical/formal level: operational configuration within standards. No rights on meaning or access policy.

## Inputs

Access decisions; retention rules; platform standards.

## Outputs

Operated environments; technical metadata; incident reports.

## Required Competencies

Database/platform operations; security operations.

## Escalation Paths

Policy conflicts → [[Data Owner]]; technical conflicts → [[Platform Architect]].
